stdout_normalized:
usage: runtime/scripts/cli.py demo gongmun [-h] --out OUT [--brief BRIEF]
                                           [--form FORM] [--polished POLISHED]
                                           [--deterministic]

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --out OUT            output directory for filled.hwpx, plan.json,
                       verdict.json, and approval.json
  --brief BRIEF        path to brief JSON (default: <engine-
                       root>/examples/gongmun/brief.json)
  --form FORM          path to blank form HWPX (default: <engine-
                       root>/tests/corpus/forms/converted/gianmun-
                       byeolji-1ho.hwpx)
  --polished POLISHED  optional polished body draft file for Policy (ii)
                       fidelity audit
  --deterministic      pin timestamps, UUIDs, and volatile metadata (or set
                       RIGORLOOM_DETERMINISTIC=1)
